messages:
nina: Postmortem follow-up: recurring autoscaler thrash + GPU headroom exhaustion. Need concrete owners and short ETAs.

marco: Short summary: bursts (30-90s) -> autoscaler doesn't react fast enough -> scheduler queues grow -> fairness breaks. Seen on eval and retrain jobs.

pavel: Action 1: Scheduler lease window tweak - add 'short_lease' mode (30s) to reduce queue tail. Owner: @pavel. ETA: 2026-04-07. Acceptance: 95th queue depth during synthetic 60s burst <= baseline 75th.

marco: Action 2: Quota backstop at routing - soft-throttle when tenant >45% reserved for >60s. Owner: @marco. ETA: 2026-04-03. Acceptance: single-tenant headroom events down by 50% in test.

nina: Action 3: Headroom alerting + dashboard tile. Owner: @nina. ETA: 2026-03-29. Acceptance: alert within 10s of sustained queue growth and dashboard shows per-tenant reservation.

devops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: scheduler-short-lease -> shadow on perf for 1h 2026-03-30T05:00Z (CI#9001).

pavel: I'll add telemetry: lease_attempts, lease_success_rate, avg_lease_dur. Pushing to headroom namespace. ETA: 2026-03-27.

marco: Run plan: 1) synthetic bursts 2x/5x, 2) compare tail latency and GPU utilization variance, 3) compare with control. Owner: @marco. ETA: publish results 2026-04-05.

nina: Runbook update: add 'burst triage' CLI checks and rollback steps. Owner: @nina. ETA: 2026-03-28. CLI snippet to include:
```
redwoodctl metrics query --ns headroom --metric headroom_free_gpus --window 30s
redwoodctl sched leases --cluster perf --last 5m
```

pavel: Suggest weekly 30-min follow-up for 4 weeks post-rollout to watch regressions. I'll schedule. Start: 2026-04-09.

marco: I'll coordinate billing check for pre-warm impacts with finance and tag the tracker. ETA: 2026-03-31.

nina: Please add a one-line daily status until items are marked in-progress. Thanks.

marco: ack :thumbsup:

pavel: ack :rocket:

devops-bot: task-bot: TASK-9009 created "short_lease rollout" assigned to pavel, due 2026-04-07.
